identityRule: ID plus marker and exact violation/check route below are immutable intent identities authenticated by this file's preseal hash. They are not source, compiled-module or executed-load identities.
materialization: Only after authorized candidate inspection: independently bind exact original and edited bytes/modes, edit hunk/AST target, emitted closure, package membership, URL, SHA256, declaration impact and trigger witness in a NEW sealed record. Missing/nonunique target is BLOCKED, not substitute violation. No current source read, textual hash-only kill or fabricated transformed hash.
loadRule: Fresh positive-before/mutant/positive-after workers. Real nextLoad must return the frozen transformed target bytes at the intended resolved URL; evaluation/branch witness must report the exact marker from that actually loaded module. Require target trigger plus ordinary targeted predicate failure while unrelated sentinel controls remain valid. Witness plumbing is sealed separately from the defect; witness-only control must preserve semantics. Loader denial/startup78/compile failure/timeout/unloaded marker cannot count as semantic mutant detection.
